posts.title: Open Source Burnout Claims Another Project
posts.description: Yet another OSS maintainer quits because of burnout. To fix this, we need better mental health resources for maintainers.

posts.title: npmx: A Lesson in Open Source's Collaboration Feedback Loops

posts.title: Binary Dependencies: Identifying the Hidden Packages We All Depend On
posts.description: We need better tools for uncovering phantom binary dependencies. Not having these tools makes our global tech infrastructure less secure, and puts a strain on the Open Source maintainers we rely on.
